findings.description: The cycle guard was removed from the walk over the __cause__ chain, so a cyclic chain now loops forever.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a retried call raises an exception whose __cause__ chain forms a cycle (e.g., a.__cause__ = b and b.__cause__ = a, which Python allows when assigned manually), and no exception in the cycle matches exception_cause_types. Mechanism: the while loop on line 180 never reaches None and never hits the seen-set break that was just deleted, so each iteration keeps following the cycle. Impact: the retry decision never returns, so the calling thread hangs instead of retrying or raising.
